lines.zh: 我从洞里爬出来，拍拍土。
lines.en: I climb out of my burrow and dust off.

lines.zh: 我沿着根系下的通道走。
lines.en: I walk the tunnels beneath the roots.
I shuffle along with something in my arms.
I squeeze sideways through a rock gap.
I keep to the wall, careful.

lines.zh: 我朝自己的洞穴走回去。
lines.en: I head back to my den.
I stop at each step to listen.
I wander near the great root tree.

lines.zh: 我搬着一块石头往前挪。
lines.en: I shift a stone forward as I go.
I go round the city's doorway.
I walk slowly so I don't startle anyone.
I withdraw into the dark.
I squat by the burrow and watch you.
I push something into the burrow.
I rub my palms together.
It's warm below; I'm in no hurry.
I'm counting my stores.
I poke my head out and sniff.
My eyes have adjusted to the dark.
I slowly sit down.
I count water drops inside the burrow.

lines.zh: 我把一样东西藏到身后。
lines.en: I hide something behind me.
I scratch a few marks on the wall.

lines.zh: 这里没人能找到我的东西。
lines.en: No one can find my things here.
I squint at your hands.

lines.zh: 我在数洞顶挂着的菌灯。
lines.en: I count the fungus lamps hanging from the ceiling.
I don't much like bright fire.

lines.zh: 我等着，看你拿什么出来。
lines.en: I wait to see what you bring out.
I lean on a great root to rest.
The echoes below comfort me.
Is that fruit in your hand?

lines.zh: 你手里有没有果子，先给我看。
lines.en: Show me first whether you brought fruit.
Have you come to trade?

lines.zh: 我不太信任上面的来客。
lines.en: I don't much trust visitors from above.
Set it down and step back.

lines.zh: 我在地下城市，围着大树住。
lines.en: I live around the great root in the undercity.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼睛，看你说不说真话。
lines.en: I watch your eyes to see if you lie.
Don't touch things here.
I study your boots from the wall.
You're standing too near my doorway.
I watch you from behind the earthen wall.
I've never seen clothes like yours.
I hop back into the shadows.
I clutch my things tight.
This one on my shoulder — noted.

lines.zh: 泥水渗进伤口，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Mud seeps into the wound; I shake myself.
I retreat into the den, half in.
I brush the soil from my clothes.

lines.zh: 土墙塌了一角，我往里钻。
lines.en: A corner of the dirt wall fell; I squeeze deeper.
I've marked your shape.
I cover my head and shrink into the dirt.
I can still trade.
Fruit! That's my favorite.
I'll stop hiding at once.
Hold it up; I'll come over slowly.

lines.zh: 这味道很甜，很久没闻到。
lines.en: Sweet, and long unseen.
Let's trade; I have something.
I reach out and take it.
This bite, I'll eat first.
Don't rush off; there's more.
I taste it and nod.
I'm fond of this kind of fruit.
You bumped me and I backed into the burrow.
The tunnel is narrow; we're stuck together.
I squeeze past you sideways.
The passage is too narrow.

lines.zh: 我抱着的苔藓撒了一地。
lines.en: The moss I was carrying spills everywhere.
I steady myself on the earthen wall.

lines.zh: 地下城市的根须，是我们种的。
lines.en: The root trees of the undercity are ours.

lines.zh: 我贴着大根树挪开一步。
lines.en: I sidle a step along the great root.
I back off and keep going.
Only one can pass here.

lines.zh: 另一个穴居者从洞里出来。
lines.en: Another burrower comes out of a den.

lines.zh: 我们一起数存下来的东西。
lines.en: We count our stores together.
Her den holds many pottery shards.

lines.zh: 我把最好的果子分她一半。
lines.en: I split the best fruit with her.
We sit side by side on the earthen steps.
This den is enough for both of us.
Our palms press together.

lines.zh: 上面的世界我们都不喜欢。
lines.en: Neither of us likes the world above.
The lamp below glows a while.
I'll come again tomorrow.
I lift the stone.
This is mine; I found it.
I stuff it into my bag.
One glance and I hide it.
This ore needs both arms.

lines.zh: 我用根须把箱子捆起来。
lines.en: I lash the crate with a root tendril.
I wrap it in cloth.
This is worth keeping.
I'll hide it and look later.
I could use this.

lines.zh: 我住在地下城市的老根旁。
lines.en: I live by the great roots of the underground city.
I lean half my body out.
I stare at it.
Step back and I'll come.
I'm fixed; I won't look elsewhere.
I edge out of the burrow slowly.
Its smell is strong.
Let me look at your fruit basket first.
I shift out of the burrow.
Leave it there, don't move it.
I edge forward along the wall.
I've strayed a bit from my burrow.

lines.zh: 我又回头看了一下洞穴。
lines.en: I glance back at my den.
The soil between us thins.
I reach out and pause.
I look up at you once.

lines.zh: 地下城市的根须，我认得路。
lines.en: Under the underground city, I know the roots.
You haven't moved; good.
I lower my hand.
There, I have it.

lines.zh: 我低头用头顶撞你的腰。
lines.en: I duck and butt my head into your hip.
My claws are packed with hard clay.
Not strong, but solid.
I fling wet clay at your eyes.
I fling a handful of dirt.

lines.zh: 我退回洞里，只露出半张脸。
lines.en: I retreat into the burrow, half my face showing.
I don't want this to grow.
I call out, warning you.
I snatch up a stone and raise it.
I lower my hand again.

lines.zh: 我从地下城的洞口出来。
lines.en: I come out of the underground city's doorway.
Soil falls; I poke my head out.
A burrower, just up from the den.
I brush the dirt off myself.
I'm carrying a pile of things.

lines.zh: 大根树的根须里有个入口。
lines.en: There's an opening in the great root's tendrils.
I squint against the light.

lines.zh: 我先看看四周有没有别人。
lines.en: First I check if anyone else is about.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从阴影里挪出来。
lines.en: I shift slowly out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 我从大根树的裂缝里探头。
lines.en: I poke my head out of a crack in the great root.
I squat and wait for you to speak.
I squat with my arms full.

lines.zh: 火光一照，我立刻往后缩。
lines.en: The flare of fire and I shrink back.

lines.zh: 我从洞壁滑下去，摔在土上。
lines.en: I slide down the wall and land in soil.

lines.zh: 水灌进洞里，我呛得厉害。
lines.en: Water floods the den and I choke.

lines.zh: 洞顶塌了，我被埋在土里。
lines.en: The den roof caves in and buries me.
An arrow sticks in my arm.

lines.zh: 那道光让我看不清东西。
lines.en: The light leaves me unable to see.
My stores have run out.

lines.zh: 雷声顺着根须传下来，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Thunder travels down the roots and I flinch.
There's no soil here to dig.
